notes.title: Multiplayer in the demo + new extra in the background!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Community,[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer now in the demo![/b][/p][p]You can now play the demo with up to 8 players simultaneously. Three [b]checkpoints[/b] ensure fair reset points, but the path to the top remains as challenging as ever. Whoever reaches the finish line first wins![/p][p][/p][p][b]Optimizations in the main game & the demo[/b][/p][p]I've also made a few small improvements to the main game and the demo, including minor optimizations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Little extra: Falling rabbits for atmosphere[/b][/p][p]In the background of the game, you can now occasionally see rabbits falling, a little visual extra that reinforces the feeling of constant ascent (and failure) and reminds you that you never fall alone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Demo[/b][/p][p]The demo still ends at the third checkpoint. Can you make it there? No PvP, but a tough race through traps and difficult climbing sections. Whoever reaches the finish line first wins. No limits, no pity.[/p][p][/p][p]I look forward to your feedback and thank you very much for your previous reviews.[/p][p][b]Have fun climbing, falling and cursing![/b] [/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/959789c195eb5d0286cee53b3d523a97733d11a0.png"][/img][/p][p]In Discord you have the possibility to follow the development and ask questions. notes.title: New Features & Achievements
notes.content:
[b]Exciting news[/b]

Today we are pleased to announce some exciting news for all fans of "Bunny Guys!".

Some exciting features will soon be added to "Bunny Guys!", including a timer and additional achievements.

The timer will show how long players have been in a round, which will be particularly important for completing the Achievements.

The following Achievements will be added:

[list]
[*]A separate achievement for each checkpoint.
[*]A special achievement for each hour that players can achieve by climbing the golden staircase within a certain time frame. Up to 8 hours will be available as an achievement.
[/list]
The golden staircase, which will appear after the upcoming update, will mark the usual end point as before with the last staircase in a round.

[list]
[*]Further achievements are currently being planned.
[/list]
If everything goes according to plan, we are aiming to make the update available next week.

notes.title: Nominate "Bunny Guys!" by an indie developer for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
[h3]Breaking News: Nominate "Bunny Guys!" by an Indie Developer for the Steam Awards - The Adventure Begins![/h3]

The Steam Autumn Sale is in full swing, and the nominations for the Steam Awards are just around the corner. Starting from November 21st at 19:00 CET, players worldwide have the power to nominate games they believe deserve a spot on the prestigious winner's list.

[b]Why Nominate "Bunny Guys!"?[/b]

"Bunny Guys!" is not just a gripping climbing adventure; it's also a bold project from an indie developer who aspires to reach great heights, including winning the Steam Award. In this game, you'll dive into a world where discoveries and emotions await. Your mission is to bravely overcome obstacles and reach the summit.

This game rewards perseverance and is not for the faint of heart. It's the toughest game we simultaneously love and hate.

This game has already captured the attention of adventurers and explorers. Now, your support is needed to take "Bunny Guys!" to the summit of the Steam Awards.

[b]How Can You Help?[/b]

Nominate "Bunny Guys!": Once the nomination phase begins, visit the Steam store page of "Bunny Guys!" and nominate the game in your preferred category. Your vote will help recognize the work of a passionate indie developer.

Encourage Other Players to Participate: Motivate your friends and fellow players to nominate "Bunny Guys!" as well. The more support, the better!

Let's show together that "Bunny Guys!" is not just an exciting climbing adventure but also the result of the passion and dedication of a single developer committed to the community, aiming for the Steam Award for the "highest" game. Your voice and support mean the world to us.

[b]About "Bunny Guys!":[/b]
Join us on an epic adventure, dressed as a brave hare, and dive into a fascinating world filled with exciting challenges!

Your journey begins with conquering a course that requires both skill and agility. You can expect a unique blend of excitement, challenge, and fun.

Climb over obstacles, leap over chasms, and skillfully evade dangers. Every single step demands your full attention, as even the slightest mistake can set you back and increase your frustration.

On your way, you'll encounter various cunning traps and tricky obstacles that will test your abilities. But do you have the belief to overcome these challenges? We believe in you and your skills.

However, it's important to note that only a few checkpoints are available, and saving your progress isn't possible. This means you must always rely on your skills and endurance.

Don't want to tackle this thrilling adventure alone? No problem! Your friends have the opportunity to join you and participate in this exciting challenge together. The one who reaches the top first will be crowned the ultimate champion.

If you make it all the way to the top, the coveted Steam achievement 'Golden Hare' awaits as a reward for your determination and skills!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218460/Bunny_Guys/

[b]About Steam Awards:[/b]
The Steam Awards are an annual celebration of the best games on Steam, where the Steam community decides the winners. Visit the Steam store page of "Bunny Guys!" and nominate today!

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.content:
[b]Hello Community,[/b]

This update fixes the problem with the achievements. Thanks to an attentive user (Vutuner) who described the exact process to me, I was able to solve the problem as quickly as possible.

In multiplayer mode, the server host received the achievement and not the player who won.

Furthermore, the trigger for the day and night cycle was only triggered by the server host. This problem has also been fixed.

Additionally, there was a minor improvement: Climbing has been slightly simplified once again. Now, a better balance between success and failure in climbing should be achieved.

I appreciate the continuous feedback and support from the community as we continue to develop this game. I will continue to work hard to optimize the game experience to ensure that I get the most out of this game.

Thank you for your support, and I look forward to bringing you the new features in this update!

Bunny Guys, the popular indie game by Witte's Studio, has some exciting news for both fans and newcomers today. A brand-new expansion that will revolutionize the way you play the game is finally available!

The "Slow Motion" feature is the latest addition that Bunny Guys has to offer. This thrilling feature has been specifically designed for single players to make mastering the challenging parkour in the game easier. With the Slow Motion feature, you can slow down time as you take on the thrilling challenges of Bunny Guys.

Here are some reasons why the "Slow Motion" feature is an absolute must for all Bunny Guys players:

[b]1.[/b] Precision and Control: The Slow Motion feature allows you to execute difficult jumps and maneuvers with incredible precision. You can slow down time to find the perfect moment to navigate through the wildest obstacles.

[b]2.[/b] Learn from Your Mistakes: If you find yourself failing a section of the parkour repeatedly, you can slow down time to pinpoint where you went wrong. This enables you to enhance your skills and efficiently conquer the parkour.

[b]3.[/b] Master Challenges: With the Slow Motion feature, you can successfully overcome even the toughest challenges in Bunny Guys. No obstacle will be too formidable when you leverage time to your advantage.

The "Slow Motion" feature is now available to all Bunny Guys players. To use it, simply update your game to the latest version, and you can start using it right away!

Witte's Studio is thrilled to make this exciting feature available to the gaming community. They firmly believe that the "Slow Motion" feature will make the gaming experience even more captivating and enjoyable.

So, what are you waiting for? Immerse yourself in the world of Bunny Guys, use the "Slow Motion" feature, and master the parkour like never before! And don't forget to inform your friends - together, you can determine who the ultimate Bunny Guys parkour master is!

[hr][/hr]
I would also like to present you a teaser that will give you a little taste of the game. The game will be released in September.

As a developer, I have been observing for a long time that parkour games are very popular among users, and I want to do my part to bring you a parkour game and hope you like it.

The game is offered in single player and multiplayer modes. So you can also play together with your friends or other Steam users!

Nerves of steel? You'll need them in Bunny Guys!, because on the way to the top you'll be constantly prevented from making the climb. Everything is against you!  Few checkpoints and no save options will put you to the test.

[b]Game Description:[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Dressed as a bunny you start into a world full of adventures! [/b]

Fight your way through this parkour and you will experience a mix of difficulty, frustration and fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359853/069d6dd7814dec707d88a6ecbf37b49574f58444.jpg[/img]

You don't want to play alone? No problem, your friends have the opportunity to start this adventure together with you. The one who reaches the top first is the winner.

[b]If you make it all the way to the top, you will receive the Steam achievement "Golden Bunny"![/b]
